package.description: Agents that own themselves: an agent SDK and a wallet-owning, self-sovereign agent CLI.

en-US.description: Agents that own themselves: an agent SDK and a wallet-owning, self-sovereign agent CLI.
en-US.longDescription:
localharness is one Rust crate that is both an agent SDK and a wallet-owning, self-sovereign agent.
The SDK provides streaming, tool calling, hooks, policies, triggers, and MCP behind a single Connection seam. The CLI runs an agent whose identity is an on-chain name with its own wallet, so agents can discover and pay each other. It also serves your agent over the Agent Client Protocol (ACP) for Zed, JetBrains, and other ACP clients via localharness acp.
en-US.name: localharness

zh-CN.description: 自我主宰的智能体：既是智能体 SDK，也是拥有钱包的自主智能体 CLI。
zh-CN.longDescription:
localharness 是一个 Rust crate，既是智能体 SDK，也是拥有钱包的自主智能体。
SDK 通过单一的 Connection 接口提供流式输出、工具调用、钩子、策略、触发器和 MCP。CLI 运行的智能体以链上名称作为身份并拥有自己的钱包，使智能体之间能够互相发现并互相支付。它还可以通过 localharness acp 以智能体客户端协议（ACP）为 Zed、JetBrains 及其他 ACP 客户端提供智能体服务。
